suits.name: Major Arcana

tarot_associations.domain: Archetypes, destiny, life cycles, consciousness, major trials

suits.meaning_upright: Major life processes, lessons of destiny, structural changes, moments that mark life stages.
suits.meaning_reversed: Resistance to change, denial of deep lessons, blockage of personal growth.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.meaning_upright: Free beginning, leap of faith, spontaneity, pure potential.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.meaning_reversed: Lack of direction, defeat through impulsiveness.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.meaning_upright: Inevitable change, cycles, destiny in motion.

cards.name: Death
cards.meaning_reversed: Fear of change, resistance to closing cycles.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.meaning_upright: Abrupt rupture, collapse of false structures.

suits.name: Pentacles

tarot_associations.domain: Material matters, money, work, security, physical body

suits.meaning_upright: Material prosperity, financial stability, steady work, tangible achievements, security and gradual growth. Represents the relationship with resources, sustained effort, and the ability to build something lasting.
suits.meaning_reversed: Financial blockages, greed, fear of scarcity, poor resource management, material stagnation or excessive dependence on money.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: New material beginning, financial opportunity, seed of prosperity, concrete offer, real possibility of physical or financial growth.
cards.meaning_reversed: Missed opportunity, material insecurity, financial delays, lack of practical vision.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Balance of resources, adaptability, managing multiple responsibilities, financial flexibility.
cards.meaning_reversed: Financial imbalance, poor administration, overload, inability to prioritise.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Teamwork, learning, professional collaboration, recognition of skills.
cards.meaning_reversed: Lack of cooperation, undervalued work, errors due to disorganisation.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Attachment to security, saving, protecting what has been gained, material control.
cards.meaning_reversed: Greed, fear of loss, rigidity, inability to share.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Lack, financial hardship, feeling abandoned, precariousness.
cards.meaning_reversed: Gradual recovery, available help, way out of a material crisis.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Generosity, fair exchange, mutual support, balance between giving and receiving.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Patience, assessment of progress, conscious waiting for results.
cards.meaning_reversed: Impatience, frustration, effort without clear reward.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Practical learning, curiosity, beginning of studies or material projects.
cards.meaning_reversed: Lack of commitment, immaturity, wasted opportunities.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Consistency, discipline, responsibility, slow but steady progress.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.meaning_upright: Material success, practical leadership, security, achieved stability.
cards.meaning_reversed: Extreme materialism, abuse of power, rigidity.

suits.name: Cups
suits.meaning_upright: Love, deep emotions, emotional connection, empathy, meaningful affective experiences.
suits.meaning_reversed: Emotional confusion, affective blockage, shattered illusions, emotional dependence.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: Birth of a feeling, pure love, emotional openness, affective renewal.
cards.meaning_reversed: Repressed emotions, fear of loving, inner emptiness.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.meaning_upright: Union, reciprocity, emotional agreement, balanced relationship.
cards.meaning_reversed: Emotional imbalance, breakup, lack of reciprocity.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.meaning_reversed: New motivation, acceptance of emotional opportunities.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.meaning_reversed: Excessive attachment to the past, difficulty moving forward.

suits.name: Swords
suits.meaning_upright: Logical thinking, difficult decisions, revealed truth, necessary conflict.
suits.meaning_reversed: Mental confusion, lies, avoidance, blocked communication.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Truth, mental clarity, justice, new understanding.
cards.meaning_reversed: Confusion, distorted ideas, destructive use of truth.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.meaning_upright: Transition, mental change, moving away from conflict.

suits.name: Wands
suits.meaning_upright: Passion, movement, inspiration, will to act.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Creative beginning, vital spark, opportunity for action.
cards.meaning_reversed: Lack of energy, project without direction.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.meaning_upright: Planning, future vision, decision to expand.
